newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon says awarded $500 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon says awarded $500 mln contract.

text.p: Raytheon Corp said Tuesday it was awarded a $500 million contract by the Air Force Electronic Systems Center at Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts.
Raytheon said the indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity prime contract is for its command and control product lines program.
The company said the comand and control program is designed to reduce the development time and costs associated with buying software-intensive command and control systems.

Raytheon said that under its five-year contract, it will develop systems that reuse commercial off-the-shelf hardware and software, or that reuse software developed by the government for previous applications.
